written_before: any pyramiding result. Inputs used: the SC-FUT-0005 frozen rule and Topstep's published thresholds. No pyramid P&L, pass rate or cash figure chose a number below.

pyramid.step: step_ticks = ceil(sigma_at_entry_check x open_of_day_in_ticks): one noise-band width at the check that opened the leg
pyramid.adds: while a leg is open, resting stop orders at entry +/- k x step (k = 1, 2, 3) in the leg's direction; at most 4 units in total per leg
pyramid.monitoring: 1-minute bars strictly after the entry minute and strictly before the exit minute (the exit fills at the exit bar's open)
pyramid.fill: long: max(trigger, bar open) once the bar high reaches the trigger; short: min(trigger, bar open) once the bar low reaches it; several triggers can fill in one bar
pyramid.exit: all units exit with the leg, at the leg's exit fill (signal exit or flatten); a reversal starts a new leg at 1 unit
pyramid.costs: L3 per unit round trip (each add is one more MNQ round trip)
pyramid.intraday_equity: units held at once: each minute's equity is the realised P&L of closed units plus every open unit's adverse/favourable extreme in that minute

benchmarks.matched_control: the SC-FUT-0005 legs (same times and base fills) with random direction (same 500 seeded draws as SC-FUT-0005); each random leg pyramids by the identical rule on its own open profit

risk: every day is capped by the $1,000 Topstep daily loss limit set at purchase (not a violation). The uncapped worst day is reported as a diagnostic only; the max of 4 units is not changed after results. (Plan draft said 'lower the max if the worst day exceeds the DLL'; replaced before any result because the DLL already caps the day and the check would need a look at results.)

gates.cash_gate: portfolio.evaluate, one sleeve (MNQ, base 1), 42-day Combine -> XFA lifecycle, Topstep 50K rules + $1,000 DLL, L3. PASS needs all three: mean net cash > $0; lower 90% bound of (net cash - luck net cash) > $0; chance of any payout within the stated range
gates.cells: 2 pricing plans (standard, no_activation_fee) x 2 payout paths (standard, consistency) = 4 cells, each one trial; the card passes only if at least one cell passes, and the exam (later, Jason's go-ahead) uses the passing cell with the highest lower bound
gates.workbench_supporting: per-base-unit $/day vs matched control and Sharpe are reported, not gated
gates.no_retuning: no other step sizes or unit caps on this card; a failure is recorded as is

honesty: noise_area family: one more distinct settings trial in the workbench ledger, plus 4 prop cash cells
